title: Structure and Written Expression
description: Section 2: 40 questions in 25 minutes. Complete sentences in Structure and find the one error in Written Expression.

id.title: Structure and Written Expression
id.description: Section 2: 40 soal dalam 25 menit. Lengkapi kalimat di bagian Structure dan temukan satu kesalahan di bagian Written Expression.

nodes.title: Structure: Subjects, Verbs and Clauses
nodes.summary: Complete the sentence by finding what is missing: a subject, a verb or a connector.

objectives.text: Decide whether an incomplete sentence is missing a subject, a main verb or a clause connector
Check that each clause has exactly one subject and one main verb
Complete sentences with relative, adverb and reduced clauses (e.g. 'Founded in 1636, Harvard…')

id.title: Structure: Subjek, Kata Kerja dan Klausa
id.summary: Lengkapi kalimat dengan menemukan yang hilang: subjek, kata kerja atau kata penghubung.

objectives.missing-element: Menentukan apakah kalimat rumpang kekurangan subjek, kata kerja utama atau penghubung klausa
objectives.one-verb-rule: Memeriksa bahwa setiap klausa punya tepat satu subjek dan satu kata kerja utama
objectives.reduced-clauses: Melengkapi kalimat dengan relative clause, adverb clause dan reduced clause (mis. 'Founded in 1636, Harvard…')

nodes.title: Verb Forms, Tenses and Passive
nodes.summary: Pick the right tense, voice and form after auxiliaries and other verbs.

objectives.text: Choose the correct tense from time clues (since, by the time, in 1900)
Distinguish active and passive forms and use the past participle correctly
Use the correct form after modals, have/be and verbs that take a gerund or infinitive

id.title: Bentuk Kata Kerja, Tenses dan Pasif
id.summary: Memilih tense, bentuk aktif/pasif dan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat setelah auxiliary dan kata kerja lain.

objectives.tense-choice: Memilih tense yang benar dari petunjuk waktu (since, by the time, in 1900)
objectives.passive-forms: Membedakan bentuk aktif dan pasif serta memakai past participle dengan benar
objectives.verb-after-verb: Memakai bentuk yang benar setelah modal, have/be dan kata kerja yang diikuti gerund atau infinitive

nodes.title: Inversion, Conditionals and Comparisons
nodes.summary: Handle the less common patterns that Structure items like to test.

objectives.text: Complete sentences with inverted word order after negative or place expressions (Not only…, Seldom…, In the forest lies…)
Complete conditional sentences, including forms without 'if' (Had they known…)
Complete comparative and superlative structures (the more…, the more…; as… as)

id.title: Inversi, Pengandaian dan Perbandingan
id.summary: Menguasai pola-pola yang jarang dipakai tetapi sering diuji di soal Structure.

objectives.inversion: Melengkapi kalimat dengan susunan terbalik setelah ungkapan negatif atau tempat (Not only…, Seldom…, In the forest lies…)
objectives.conditionals: Melengkapi kalimat pengandaian, termasuk bentuk tanpa 'if' (Had they known…)
objectives.comparisons: Melengkapi struktur komparatif dan superlatif (the more…, the more…; as… as)

nodes.title: Written Expression: Find the Error
nodes.summary: Four underlined parts, one must be changed.

objectives.text: Check each underlined part against its neighbours instead of reading for meaning only
Spot wrong word forms (noun, verb, adjective, adverb) in the underlined parts
Spot errors with singular/plural nouns, countable/uncountable nouns and articles

id.title: Written Expression: Temukan Kesalahan
id.summary: Empat bagian bergaris bawah, satu harus diubah.

objectives.method: Memeriksa setiap bagian bergaris bawah terhadap kata di sekitarnya, bukan hanya membaca maknanya
objectives.word-form: Menemukan bentuk kata yang salah (nomina, verba, adjektiva, adverbia) di bagian bergaris bawah
objectives.nouns-articles: Menemukan kesalahan pada nomina tunggal/jamak, nomina terhitung/tak terhitung dan artikel

nodes.title: Agreement, Parallelism and Pronouns
nodes.summary: The classic Written Expression errors: subject–verb agreement, parallel lists and pronoun reference.

objectives.text: Spot subject–verb agreement errors when the subject and verb are far apart
Spot items in a list or pair (and, or, both… and) that are not parallel
Spot pronouns and possessives that do not agree with the noun they refer to

id.title: Kesesuaian, Paralelisme dan Pronomina
id.summary: Kesalahan klasik Written Expression: kesesuaian subjek–kata kerja, daftar yang paralel dan rujukan pronomina.

objectives.subject-verb: Menemukan kesalahan kesesuaian subjek–kata kerja ketika subjek dan kata kerjanya berjauhan
objectives.parallel: Menemukan unsur dalam daftar atau pasangan (and, or, both… and) yang tidak paralel
objectives.pronoun-agreement: Menemukan pronomina dan posesif yang tidak sesuai dengan nomina yang dirujuknya

nodes.title: 40 Questions in 25 Minutes
nodes.summary: Work through the whole section at a steady pace with a personal error checklist.

objectives.text: Complete a full 15 + 25 question set within 25 minutes
Apply a fixed checklist (verb, agreement, word form, parallelism, article) to each Written Expression item
Identify the two grammar patterns that cost the most points in a practice set

id.title: 40 Soal dalam 25 Menit
id.summary: Menyelesaikan satu section penuh dengan tempo stabil dan daftar periksa kesalahan pribadi.

objectives.pace: Menyelesaikan satu set lengkap 15 + 25 soal dalam 25 menit
objectives.error-checklist: Menerapkan daftar periksa tetap (verba, kesesuaian, bentuk kata, paralelisme, artikel) pada tiap soal Written Expression
objectives.weak-patterns: Menemukan dua pola grammar yang paling banyak mengurangi poin dalam satu set latihan
